name: M3_PPS100MI_GetAgrLine
description: Retrieve purchase agreement line details for a specific supplier and agreement. This operation returns the full definition of one agreement line based on its key fields. It includes identities (supplier, agreement number, group identity, start values, validity dates), commercial terms (purchase price and setup price, currency, discounts, units of measure), commitments and bonus indicators, supply lead time and rental duration, country of origin and warranty limits, and audit information such as creation and change data. The data reflects the line as maintained in Purchase Agreement. Open and its related price-entry functions and can be used to validate purchasing, reporting, or integrations.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Supplier number identifying the supplier that owns the agreement line to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: AGNB
inputParameters.description: Agreement number identifying the purchase agreement that contains the line to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: GRPI
inputParameters.description: Group identity that defines the key combination used to classify and find the agreement line.

inputParameters.name: OBV1
inputParameters.description: Primary start value in the group identity used, together with the group ID, to identify the specific agreement line.

inputParameters.name: FVDT
inputParameters.description: Valid-from date of the agreement line to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the agreement line is retrieved.

inputParameters.name: OBV2
inputParameters.description: Second start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line when used.

inputParameters.name: OBV3
inputParameters.description: Third start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line when used.

inputParameters.name: OBV4
inputParameters.description: Fourth start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line when used.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number for the agreement line.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number for the purchase agreement.

outputParameters.name: GRPI
outputParameters.description: Group identity defining how the agreement line is classified and retrieved.

outputParameters.name: OBV1
outputParameters.description: Primary start value in the group identity for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: OBV2
outputParameters.description: Second start value in the group identity for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: OBV3
outputParameters.description: Third start value in the group identity for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: OBV4
outputParameters.description: Fourth start value in the group identity for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: FVDT
outputParameters.description: Date from which this agreement line is valid.

outputParameters.name: UVDT
outputParameters.description: Date until which this agreement line is valid.

outputParameters.name: SAGL
outputParameters.description: Status of the agreement line, such as active, fulfilled, or inactive.

outputParameters.name: SUPR
outputParameters.description: Setup price for this agreement line that can be copied to purchase orders.

outputParameters.name: PUPR
outputParameters.description: Purchase price defined on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PUCD
outputParameters.description: Quantity used as the basis when expressing the purchase price on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: UASU
outputParameters.description: Controls whether and how the agreed quantity on this line updates the material plan.

outputParameters.name: DIP3
outputParameters.description: Third discount applied when calculating the net purchase price on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: AGQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity agreed with the supplier on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: VOLI
outputParameters.description: Indicator defining whether the agreed quantity represents an optional, minimum, or maximum purchase commitment.

outputParameters.name: PUQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated purchased quantity against this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PAAM
outputParameters.description: Accumulated purchased amount for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PTCD
outputParameters.description: Code for a price text to print instead of the numeric purchase price on purchase orders.

outputParameters.name: REQU
outputParameters.description: Quantity threshold at which the agreement line must be renewed.

outputParameters.name: RENA
outputParameters.description: Amount threshold in domestic currency at which the agreement line must be renewed.

outputParameters.name: BOGE
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether bonus is calculated for purchases on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: BOFO
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether purchases on this line are included when calculating bonus-generating totals.

outputParameters.name: PODI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether purchase order lines using this agreement line are included in the order-total discount base.

outputParameters.name: LEA1
outputParameters.description: Supply lead time in days associated with the item on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: WAL1
outputParameters.description: First warranty limit associated with this agreement line, typically a maximum meter value.

outputParameters.name: WAL2
outputParameters.description: Second warranty limit associated with this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: WAL3
outputParameters.description: Third warranty limit associated with this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: WAL4
outputParameters.description: Fourth warranty limit associated with this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: ORCO
outputParameters.description: Country of origin for the item on this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: DEFD
outputParameters.description: Number of detention free-time days agreed before detention charges apply.

outputParameters.name: DEFH
outputParameters.description: Number of detention free-time hours included in the agreed free-time.

outputParameters.name: DEFM
outputParameters.description: Number of detention free-time minutes included in the agreed free-time.

outputParameters.name: SEQN
outputParameters.description: Sequence number uniquely identifying the agreement line within the agreement.

outputParameters.name: WSCA
outputParameters.description: Costing model used for subcontracting cost calculations for this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PUUN
outputParameters.description: Standard purchase order unit of measure associated with this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PPUN
outputParameters.description: Standard purchase price unit of measure associated with this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: PUU1
outputParameters.description: Agreement-specific purchase quantity unit of measure for this line.

outputParameters.name: PPU1
outputParameters.description: Agreement-specific purchase price unit of measure for this line.

outputParameters.name: POR2
outputParameters.description: Legacy purchase organization value associated with this agreement line (deprecated field).

outputParameters.name: RDUR
outputParameters.description: Default rental duration used for X-hire sublines generated from this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: IFIE
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the agreement line is connected to an interface item that does not yet exist in the item master.

outputParameters.name: PORG
outputParameters.description: Purchase organization that controls which warehouses may use this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number used to track the latest change to this agreement line.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the agreement line was created.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the agreement line was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person who last created or changed the agreement line.

outputParameters.name: SRGR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this agreement line contributes to supplier rebate generating or paying totals.
